task: Review RealityStudioPreview orbit/pan/zoom bounds, cancelled gestures, reduced-motion behavior and Intel simulator fallback before RealityKit resource creation.

tests.kind: Source review only; no tests or runtime probes executed.
checks: Read worker brief, matching coordinator plan entry 080, repository AGENTS.md and docs/acceptance/m02-m03-code.md.

Inspected actual HEAD, recent log, git status, candidate-to-HEAD diff for RealityStudioPreview.swift and StudioView.swift (empty), and current StudioView.swift diff (two recovery-action styling changes unrelated to reviewed behavior).

Reviewed RealityStudioPreview.swift lines 243-275: orbit accepts began/changed, resets incremental translation, rejects nonfinite translations, wraps yaw and clamps pitch to -1.35...1.35; pan clamps each target axis to -300...300; zoom rejects nonfinite/nonpositive Float scale and clamps distance to 0.45...1500.

Reviewed cancellation and lifecycle handling: cancelled/failed/ended camera callbacks do not mutate camera; no deferred drag transaction or inertia is implemented in the RealityKit coordinator; leaving active window toggles recognizer enabled state and removes anchors; detach removes recognizers, callbacks and anchors.

Reviewed direct camera placement and reduced-motion source: RealityKit applyCamera and fit assign camera state immediately, without scheduled/tweened animation; motion blur is disabled. StudioView meter navigation skips withAnimation when accessibilityReduceMotion is enabled.

Reviewed compile-time Intel simulator branch: targetEnvironment(simulator) && arch(x86_64) selects SpatialPreview before RealityStudioSurface.makeCoordinator can initialize graph, AnchorEntity or PerspectiveCamera; previewNote also excludes StudioEntityGraph reference in this branch.

Reviewed SceneKit fallback creation and camera updates: uses SCNView/SCNScene/SCNNode; update/layout transactions set duration zero and disable actions; explicit fit/deactivation/detach stop camera inertia. Native camera gesture and inertia behavior under Reduce Motion was not executed or established by this source review.
Inspected existing StudioSmokeTests 3D mode/fit workflow source. This does not provide executed orbit/pan/pinch/cancellation evidence.
unrun: Native SceneKit fallback gestures and Reduce Motion

outcome: No confirmed material defect in the assigned RealityKit bounds/cancellation/fallback path. Source inspection supports bounded direct camera manipulation and early Intel fallback; native framework gesture/reduced-motion behavior remains unverified. No repository changes made.
